# Intelligent Management

> > A science-based management methodology combining Theory of Constraints and W. Edwards Deming principles to help organizations manage complexity, control growth, and achieve sustainable competitive advantage.

Intelligent Management provides systemic management solutions through the Decalogue methodology, training programs, and consulting services led by Dr. Domenico Lepore. The site features case studies, success stories, and educational resources demonstrating how Theory of Constraints and systems thinking drive organizational transformation.

## Key Topics

- Theory of Constraints
- W. Edwards Deming
- Decalogue methodology
- Systems thinking
- Systemic management
- Organizational complexity
- Critical Chain project management
- Conflict Cloud
- Sustainable growth
- Organizational leadership
- Management methodology
- Business strategy
- Operational excellence
- Systemic results
- Dr. Domenico Lepore

## Core Methodology

- [Intelligent Management Solutions - Science based and systems thinking](https://intelligentmanagement.ws/about-us-theory-of-constraints-deming-decalogue-management-methodology): About page describing Intelligent Management's science-based systemic approach and Decalogue methodology.
- [THE DECALOGUE SHORT OVERVIEW](https://intelligentmanagement.ws/decalogue-short-overview): Overview of the Decalogue methodology framework based on Theory of Constraints and systems thinking.
- [HOW TO](https://intelligentmanagement.ws/how-to): How-to guides for implementing the Decalogue systemic management approach.
- [Moving the Chains: An Operational Solution for Embracing Complexity in the Digital Age](https://intelligentmanagement.ws/book/moving-the-chains-operational-solution-embracing-complexity-digital-age): Book providing operational solutions for managing complexity in the digital age using systemic principles.
